content:
We’ve just updated LeanStateSearch!

You can now click the “Explore in Dependency Graph” button in the search results to view the dependencies and dependents of a constant.
image.png

For each constant, the graph also shows its AI-translated informal name and statement. (Some constants, such as those from Init, are excluded from the graph.)

We hope this new feature makes your exploration a bit easier and more insightful.
Discussion can continue in the old thread #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Lean State Search: Search Mathlib theorems with proof states @ 💬
